components.name: Unified App Rail
components.description: One constrained rail combines the Workout icon and flat primary tabs; an active workout replaces the tabs with its title, elapsed time, and actions.
components.css: .ds-rail{box-sizing:border-box;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:100%;max-width:760px;min-height:58px;margin:auto;padding:0 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:var(--font)}.ds-app-icon{display:grid;place-items:center;width:34px;height:34px}.ds-app-icon svg{width:34px;fill:none;stroke:var(--accent);stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round}.ds-rail nav{display:flex;flex:1;gap:18px;height:58px}.ds-rail button{position:relative;flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font:650 13px var(--font);cursor:pointer}.ds-rail button[aria-current="page"]{color:var(--text);box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 var(--accent)}.ds-rail button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}

components.description: Three equal 48px tabs on one bottom rule; the active tab is an accent underline rather than a pill.

components.name: Primary and Secondary Buttons
components.description: The hierarchy keeps New workout as the sole full-width primary action, with New routine and pencil-labelled Edit as visible secondary buttons beside each routine's primary Start action.

narrative.overview:
Workout is a Möbius-native training ledger, not a fitness dashboard. The interface inherits the shell’s current light or dark tokens and combines the real Workout icon with one flat primary tab rail, keeping navigation quiet beside dense set data. Ruled rows, aligned numbers, and restrained color make the record feel dependable at a glance.

The core journey is deliberately progressive: start or edit a routine, reuse a saved setup note, tap previous values into the next set, let a recoverable rest timer begin when a valid set is completed, and inspect rolling or exercise-specific progress. Library and picker rows extend in bounded batches as the user scrolls and lazily request one cached still frame; the selected exercise alone rises in an adaptive sheet and requests the animated demonstration. Catalogue and media failures never block saved routines or an active workout.
keyCharacteristics: One constrained rail combines the Workout icon and three flat tabs, then becomes the active-workout title and actions.
Three flat 58px tabs use a two-pixel accent underline instead of a pill or lifted selection.
New workout owns the home primary position; routine creation and editing stay contextual and visually quieter than Start.
History and exercise detail present derived analytics as ruled ledgers rather than dashboard cards.
Library and picker rows share continuously extending still thumbnails and equal-width arrow-free filters; only selected detail renders a GIF.
Read-only exercise and workout-log detail shares a labelled adaptive sheet with handle, backdrop, Escape, and downward dismissal.
Previous, unit, and reps share equal centered ledger width; valid completion starts a recoverable rest timer.

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce app-owned light/dark palettes. Use the shell roles exactly, including `surface-2`’s fallback to `surface`.

rules.name: The State-Color Rule
rules.body: Accent means action or current progress, green means valid completion, and danger means destructive intent. Color is never decoration.

rules.name: The Glanceable Ledger Rule
rules.body: Previous performance, current values, completion, and rolling totals stay aligned; descriptive text must not overpower them.

rules.name: The Structural Elevation Rule
rules.body: Rows, analytics cells, tabs, and ordinary containers remain flat. Shadows are reserved for sticky, modal, or transient overlay states.

dos: Do combine the app icon and flat primary tabs in one constrained root rail.
Do keep rolling and exercise-specific metrics ruled, tabular, derived, and deterministic.
Do extend library and picker results automatically in bounded batches, show one progressively cached still per row, and use a target label when official media is missing.
Do keep the two discovery filters equal-width, arrow-free, and available in both the library and picker.
Do center Previous values and give Previous, unit, and reps equal flexible ledger width.
Do use the handle-led adaptive sheet for read-only detail and close it in one continuous downward movement.
Do keep routine editing explicit with Cancel and Save actions.
Do persist the automatic rest timer with the active draft, and remove it before writing finished history.
Do remove component transitions under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
donts: Don't add a second visible app-title header or restore filled, rounded root tabs.
Don't add X or Back controls to read-only sheet headers, or dismiss to an intermediate resting point.
Don't turn analytics into a card-heavy fitness dashboard or use decorative data color.
Don't restore manual show-more controls or a fixed picker-result cap.
Don't add from a picker row, autoplay or preload multiple GIFs, or let thumbnail failure remove a usable exercise.
Don't persist derived progress beside completed sessions or introduce a second analytics record.
Don't restart a recovered countdown from its full duration or copy timer state into completed history.
Don't allow zero-rep sets to become or remain complete, or allow an empty workout to finish.
Don't imply that cross-app readers may write back into Workout’s record.
